>(Added to him/her via a master discipline card)???

>Neither are equipment or retainers
>And those are the only rules I can find
>(/No/ you can't keep retainers/equipment...)
>In regards to my question.

All cards (Vampires and Library cards), upon enetering the Ash Heap,
lose all knowledge of any other cards linked to them or played on them.

If you pull one of these cards out of the Ash Heap, it will start
afresh, just as if he had never been in play before.

This applies to the good and the bad cards (a vampire returning from the
Ash Heap would no longer be De-Evolved or Blood Bonded or have any
Seduction counters, etc.)

Messages.Body:
ANVIL wrote:

> Alright, if I give a vampire FAME
> And then that Vamp is sent to my ash heap
> Then I manage to resurrect him
> (Using one of many different ways with the Giovanni)
> Would the vampire keep FAME?
> For that matter would he also keep is disciplines
> (Added to him/her via a master discipline card)???

Nope--once a vamp hits the ash heap, and and all cards modifying the
vampire are gone with it. Even if you bring the vampo back from the ash
heap, all things that were originally on it do not come back.

> "If Elvis/Jim Morrison/Kurt Cobain (etc.) came back,
> wouldn't THEY still be famous???"

Yeah, but those guys aren't cards. :)
